plan.summary: Add a WebChat page to the SuperAdmin (ops) panel with a live chat window. Operators can view active webchat conversations and reply to visitors directly from the Dashboard.
plan.q_intent: superadmin paneline bir sayfa ekle. webchat için sohbet penceresi olsun.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new 'WebChat' nav item appears in the SuperAdmin sidebar (opsOnly) and navigates to /webchat
The WebChat page shows a list of active conversations with visitor name, email, status, and last message preview
Clicking a conversation opens a chat window showing the full message history with distinct bubble styles for visitor/operator/ai messages
Operator can type and send messages from the chat window, and the message appears in the conversation
Operator can close a conversation from the chat window
Solution build passes with zero errors

files_changed.change: Added operator proxy methods + DTOs (GetConversations, GetMessages, SendOperatorMessage, CloseConversation)
Added 4 ops webchat proxy endpoints + WebChatClient factory with internalApiKey
New WebChat page with conversation list + chat window
Added WebChat nav item with Globe icon (opsOnly)

verification_questions.question: Does the internal API key auth on WebChat properly validate and reject requests with invalid or missing keys?
Are webchat conversations and messages correctly fetched and displayed with proper sender type distinction?
Does the operator message send flow correctly proxy through Backend to WebChat preserving all business logic (SignalR, AI timer)?

non_goals: SignalR real-time updates in Dashboard (use polling)
New DB tables or schema changes
intentional_exclusions: Real-time SignalR integration from Dashboard to WebChat — polling is sufficient for superadmin v1
Closed conversation history — only active/ai conversations shown

user_facing_errors: Mesaj gonderilemedi — toast on send failure
Sohbetler yuklenemedi — error state in conversation list
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All API calls show loading/error states. WebChat proxy failures surface as HTTP errors.

aha_moments.user_pain: SuperAdmin cannot see or respond to webchat visitors without opening a separate tool
aha_moments.suggestion: Unified chat window in Dashboard with familiar messaging UI
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator opens Dashboard, clicks WebChat, sees all live conversations and can reply instantly

aha_moments.user_pain: Switching between webchat operator panel and superadmin dashboard wastes time
aha_moments.suggestion: Inline chat window eliminates context switching
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator monitors health metrics AND responds to visitors in the same browser tab

aha_moments.user_pain: No visibility into webchat conversation quality or response times
aha_moments.suggestion: Conversation list shows status badges and timestamps for at-a-glance monitoring
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees 'AI responding for 2 minutes' and jumps in to help the visitor

aha_moments.user_pain: Operator might miss messages when not monitoring the webchat widget
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-refresh every 5s keeps the conversation list current
aha_moments.aha_moment: New conversation appears in the list without manual refresh

aha_moments.user_pain: Potential leads from webchat go unnoticed
aha_moments.suggestion: Active conversation count badge helps prioritize responses
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees '3 active conversations' and immediately engages
